name: Volume-Based Topology Simplification via Augmented Reeb Graph
definition: A method to remove topological noise (handles) from isosurfaces extracted from volumetric scalar data by sweeping through the volume, encoding topology in an augmented Reeb graph, isolating handles, measuring their size, and removing small ones.
summary: This method removes topological noise from volumetric data by sweeping through slices to encode topology in an augmented Reeb graph, enabling out-of-core processing and producing a less dense graph than polygon-by-polygon methods.
